sloka: ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च महाबलम् ।चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवम् ।। ६.१११.३१ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sakāmaṁ sugrīvamaṅgadaṁ ca mahābalam ।cakāra rāghavaḥ prīto hatvā rākṣasapuṅgavam ।। 6.111.31 ।।

translations.english: When Ravana, a terror of all worlds was killed, the Charanas and Devas were filled with great joy.
